quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #24
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 18

questions.question: When you see a steady green arrow on a traffic signal, what should you do?

options.text: Merge into the lane that points in the direction of the arrow.
Slow down and stop if it is safe.
Turn in the direction of the arrow. First, yield to any cars and pedestrians already in the intersection.
Drive straight through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn in the direction of the arrow. First, yield to any cars and pedestrians already in the intersection.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can turn in that direction. You must be in the correct lane for the turn. Always yield to vehicles and pedestrians already in the intersection.

questions.question: What do pentagonal (five-sided) signs tell you?

options.text: No passing zones.
School zones.
Speed limits.
Railroad crossings.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zones.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs mark school zones. Watch carefully for children and pedestrians in these areas.

questions.question: A driver license is a:

options.text: Requirement.
Privilege.
Right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Privilege.
questions.explanation: Driving is a privilege, not a right. Everyone must drive safely and responsibly. If you misuse this privilege, it can be taken away.

questions.question: When are streets and highways most slippery?

options.text: After it has rained hard for several hours.
When they are clean and dry.
Just when rain starts to fall.

questions.correctAnswerText: Just when rain starts to fall.
questions.explanation: Roads are most slippery at the start of rain. Water mixes with oil and chemicals on the road surface that have not washed away yet. Drive with extra care during the first rain.

questions.question: What color are highway signs that show the distance to the next exit?

options.text: Yellow with black letters
Black with white letters
Red with white letters
Green with white letters

questions.correctAnswerText: Green with white letters
questions.explanation: Highway signs that give information about destinations are green with white letters or symbols.

questions.question: You are in the left lane and want to move to the right lane. What should you do?

options.text: Check mirrors, signal, and look over your left shoulder before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and look over both shoulders before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to go to check your blind spot. Always check mirrors and use your turn signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: What is the first thing you should adjust when you get in a car to drive?

options.text: Your seat belt
The steering wheel
Your rearview mirror
Your seat

questions.correctAnswerText: Your seat
questions.explanation: Adjust your seat first so you can sit comfortably and see the road clearly. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel based on where your seat is positioned.

questions.question: Another car is passing you in a no passing zone. What should you do?

options.text: Pull off the road.
Keep your speed and position the same.
Slow down and let the other car safely return to the driving lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let the other car safely return to the driving lane.
questions.explanation: Slow down to help the other driver safely get back to the correct lane. This helps avoid accidents and hazards ahead.

questions.question: When parallel parking, how far from the curb should you park?

options.text: Six inches
10 inches
14 inches
18 inches

questions.correctAnswerText: 18 inches
questions.explanation: When parallel parking, stay no more than 18 inches from the curb. Park where drivers can see your car from both directions.

questions.question: What should drivers do when driving in bad weather?

options.text: Drive faster to reach your destination sooner.
Follow other cars more closely.
Stay farther away from other cars.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther away from other cars.
questions.explanation: In wet weather, increase the distance between your car and the car ahead of you.

questions.question: Why should you be careful when passing a bicycle?

options.text: Your car is faster than the bicycle.
Bicycles always have the right-of-way.
Oncoming traffic may not see you pull out to pass.
The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid an object on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid an object on the road.
questions.explanation: Be careful when passing a bicycle because the cyclist may suddenly swerve into traffic to avoid an object on the road. Always drive carefully near bicycles.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow centerline mean?

options.text: Passing is not allowed.
You can pass on the right when the road ahead is clear.
You can pass on the left when the road ahead is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass on the left when the road ahead is clear.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow centerline means you can cross it to pass another vehicle on the left, as long as there is no oncoming traffic. Never cross a solid yellow centerline to pass.

questions.question: What is the maximum speed limit in a business or residential area unless a sign says otherwise?

options.text: 20 mph
30 mph
45 mph
55 mph

questions.correctAnswerText: 30 mph
questions.explanation: The maximum speed limit in a business or residential area is 30 miles per hour. Follow posted speed limit signs if they show a different speed.

questions.question: What can a leaking exhaust system cause?

options.text: Excessive oil use
Your vehicle needs a tune-up sooner
You feel drowsy while driving
Grass fires on country roads

questions.correctAnswerText: You feel drowsy while driving
questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes toxic gases, reduces noise, and cools hot gases from the engine. Fumes from a leaky exhaust system can be deadly and can make you drowsy while driving.

questions.question: Your car wheels go off the edge of the pavement. What should you do first?

options.text: Turn the front wheels slightly left to get back on the pavement.
Hold the steering wheel firmly, release the gas pedal, and gently apply the brakes.
Apply the brakes and turn the front wheels sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the steering wheel firmly, release the gas pedal, and gently apply the brakes.
questions.explanation: If your car leaves the road, hold the steering wheel firmly, release the gas pedal, and gently apply the brakes. Slow down, check traffic, and find a safe place to return to the road. Do not jerk the wheel sharply, as this can cause you to lose control or hit other lanes.

questions.question: Highways and roads freeze before ramps and bridges.

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: Ramps and bridges freeze faster because they are not surrounded by ground. They become icy very quickly in cold weather. Drive with extra caution on bridges during freezing temperatures.

questions.question: If a child is about to run into the street, what should you do?

options.text: Begin to slow down.
Flash your headlights.
Sound a short, loud horn blast.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sound a short, loud horn blast.
questions.explanation: If a child or pedestrian is about to enter the street in front of you, sound a short, loud horn blast. This can alert them to danger.

questions.question: You want to back out of your driveway and children are playing nearby. What should you do first?

options.text: Rev your engine to warn the children.
Sound your horn so the children will hear you.
Walk to the back of the car to check that the way is clear.
Tell the children to stay away from the driveway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk to the back of the car to check that the way is clear.
questions.explanation: Look through your back window for pedestrians and obstacles. Do not rely only on your mirrors, especially around children. Always get out and check behind your vehicle before backing up or out of a driveway.

questions.question: You approach an intersection with a flashing red light. What must you do?

options.text: Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Turn right or left because the road ahead is blocked.
Stop and wait for a flashing green light.
Stop, then go when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must come to a complete stop. Then you can proceed when the way is clear.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a hill with a curb, which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Turn them sharply toward the curb.
Turn them slightly to the right.
Turn them sharply away from the curb.
Keep them straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn them sharply away from the curb.
questions.explanation: Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb to prevent your car from rolling into traffic when parked uphill. If there is no curb, turn the wheels sharply toward the edge of the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: An intersection is ahead.
Traffic is merging.
A steep hill is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep hill is ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to possible hazards. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. You should slow down to avoid crashes and brake damage.

questions.question: What lines mark reversible lanes?

options.text: Single solid white lines.
Double dashed yellow lines.
Single dashed white lines.
Single solid yellow lines.

questions.correctAnswerText: Double dashed yellow lines.
questions.explanation: Reversible lanes carry traffic in one direction at certain times and the opposite direction at other times. These lanes are marked with double dashed yellow lines.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow X on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: The signal will soon change to a red X.
The signal will soon change to a green arrow.
You may drive normally in this lane.
You may drive slowly in this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The signal will soon change to a red X.
questions.explanation: Lane control signals show which lanes are open and closed as traffic direction changes throughout the day. A solid yellow X means you should leave the lane immediately because a red X is coming next.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow X on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: The signal will soon change to a red X.
The signal will soon change to a green arrow.
You may use this lane only to turn.
You may drive slowly in this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may use this lane only to turn.
questions.explanation: Lane control signals show which lanes are open and closed as traffic direction changes throughout the day. A flashing yellow X means you can only use this lane to make a left turn.

questions.question: You have a green light and want to turn left, but oncoming traffic is heavy. What should you do?

options.text: Use the next intersection instead.
Wait at the crosswalk for traffic to clear.
Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to clear.
Go ahead because you have the green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to clear.
questions.explanation: When turning left with oncoming traffic, you may enter the intersection if the light is green and no car ahead of you is turning left. Wait in the intersection for oncoming traffic to clear before you turn.
